mapper.select: select m.material_id, m.file_name, m.stored_name, m.file_path, m.file_size, m.category, m.visibility, m.uploader_id, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, u.nick_name as uploader_name, u.member_department as uploader_department from qt_material m left join sys_user u on m.uploader_id = u.user_id where m.material_id = #{materialId}

select m.material_id, m.file_name, m.stored_name, m.file_path, m.file_size, m.category, m.visibility, m.uploader_id, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, u.nick_name as uploader_name, u.member_department as uploader_department from qt_material m left join sys_user u on m.uploader_id = u.user_id
and m.category = #{category} and m.visibility = #{visibility} and m.file_name like concat('%', #{fileName}, '%')
and ( m.visibility = 'ALL' or (m.visibility = 'MEMBER' and #{params.isMember} = '1') or (m.visibility = 'DEPT' and u.member_department = #{params.dept}) or m.uploader_id = #{params.userId} )
order by m.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into qt_material (file_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, category, visibility, uploader_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{category}, #{visibility}, #{uploaderId}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
